title: Smoky Mexican Black Bean & Sweet Potato Stew
ingredients: 800g sweet potato, peeled and chopped into smallish cubes
2 × 400g cans black beans, drained and rinsed
To serve: lime wedges, fat-free yogurt sprinkled with smoked paprika
steps: In a large sauté pan with lid, fry onion gently in cooking spray for 5 minutes. Add garlic, sweet potato, smoked paprika, cumin and oregano; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Pour in stock; add tomatoes, tomato purée, black beans and jalapeños. Season.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes stirring occasionally, then lid on for another 15 minutes on low heat.
Check sweet potato is cooked through. Serve with lime wedges and yogurt sprinkled with smoked paprika.
notes: Can replace sweet potato with butternut squash and stir in spinach or kale at end. Grated cheese grilled on top is also delicious. Freezer-friendly.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
